evidence: Touches src/wallet/ files to streamline SQLite migration of legacy wallets and remove unused wallet database erase helpers.
rationale: Optimizing legacy wallet migration by filtering records upfront rather than writing and erasing them avoids redundant disk I/O and drops dead database helpers. The author notes that 'transaction records are already being rewritten by migration, so not writing them in the first place is also fine', enabling the removal of functions like EraseTx and EraseRecords.
